raw_segments.text: I say this in case we become bad," Alyosha went on,

"'Let us all be generous and brave like Ilusha, clever, brave, and generous like Kolya, though he will be ever so much cleverer when he is grown up, and let us all be as modest, as clever and sweet as Kartashov. But why am I talking about those two? You are all dear to me, boys, from this day forth. I have a place in my heart for you all, and I beg you to keep your eyes open for me."

Well, and who has united us in this kind, good feeling which we shall remember and intend to remember all our lives? Who, if not, Ilusha, the good boy, the dear boy, precious to us forever? Let us never forget him. May his memory live forever in our hearts from this time forth.
